permissions.reason: Query your Slurm jobs and owned-job details on demand.
Preview up to 64 KiB from scheduler-reported stdout/stderr inside an owned job's directory.
Submit only a batch script you review and explicitly confirm for this host and directory.
Cancel only one owned non-array job after you confirm its exact ID.

contributions.title: HPC jobs
contributions.text: List your Slurm jobs on demand, including state, runtime, node count and pending reason.

contributions.title: HPC job details
contributions.text: Inspect one owned job or array task. Requires Slurm JSON support.

contributions.title: HPC job logs
contributions.text: Read a bounded stdout/stderr tail on demand.

contributions.title: Submit HPC job
contributions.text: Review a complete script and explicitly confirm submission. No automatic retry.

contributions.title: Cancel HPC job
contributions.text: Confirm one exact owned job ID. Array cancellation is not supported.

contributions.title: HPC accounting
contributions.text: Owned job and step statistics from sacct, past seven days.
